summary: Tower erected at West Plains in fiscal 1954-55; a 2015 Missouri Department of Conservation plan describes the site as in use for fire detection.

facts.status_note: Last described as in use in a 2015 Department plan; no later source found.

access.note: 2015 plan, West Plains appendix: the area is not open to the public.

events.note: Annual report for fiscal 1954-55: a new tower was erected at West Plains
Department plan records the towersite as acquired in 1955, 2 acres, Howell County
Annual report for fiscal 1971-72: the West Plains tower road was oil sealed
Department plan: three Department and Howell County 911 radio relays; tower used for fire detection by Department staff
Department plan says the towersite is likely eligible for the National Register of Historic Places

notes_for_editor: Status and staffing rest on a 2015 plan; nothing read confirms the tower in 2026. No height, design or fire history found. Access (not open to the public) comes from the 2015 plan's West Plains appendix. The Missouri Life and News-Leader articles returned 403 and were not read. The agency correction follows the 2015 plan.
